description: Havells, the leading brand for electric products in India, offers an extensive range of kitchen and home appliances at competitive prices. Its variety of products includes blenders, choppers, food processors, juicers, mixer grinders, etc. If we talk particularly about juicers, Havells offers a wide range of cold press slow juicers, citrus press juicers, and more. Havells juice machines are easy to use and absolutely mess-free. All the juicers feature powerful motors, together with speed control, stainless steel blades and food-grade plastic body. Amongst others, nutri art 200W cold press slow juicer by Havells gets the limelight due to its patented slow squeeze technology, featuring 70 RPM speed that mimics juice extraction by hand. This cold press slow juicer also comes with a smoothie maker attachment. It easily extracts 75% more juice from fruits, vegetables, wheatgrass, and soy.
